issues.description: The UML/problem statement declares a boolean attribute named 'excellentEnough' for ExcellenceLand, but the solution implementation declares the field as 'isExcellent' with getter 'isExcellent()'. This identifier mismatch between the specification and the provided solution can confuse students about the exact attribute name and expected getter to implement and may cause test mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier names consistent. Either update the solution to declare the boolean field as 'private boolean excellentEnough;' with a corresponding public getter (e.g. 'public boolean isExcellentEnough()' or 'public boolean getExcellentEnough()'), or update the UML/problem statement to use 'isExcellent' so all artifacts use the same name.
